ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the central lobe regions and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated at the trailing edges, tips, and central notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white regions occupy the center of both lobes. A dark, low-intensity vertical band extends from the median notch downwards. Yellowish-tan mottling is localized in the mid-to-lower quadrant of the right lobe. Sparse, dark-grey punctate spots are visible on the lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge characterized by irregular triangular peaks and U-shaped valleys. Serration amplitude increases towards the distal tips, with a frequency of approximately 8-10 major peaks per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral upward sweep exhibiting a convex lower margin and a complex, generally concave trailing margin from notch to tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. One isolated, circular tan-colored focal spot is located on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, dark, near-vertical linear streaks are detected on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both fluke tips. A large area of yellowish discoloration (potential bio-fouling or scarring) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water droplets and spray patterns occluding small portions of the central dark pigmentation.
